negative.sentenceEn: He found negative effects on blood sugar and insulin levels when food provided excess calories from sugars, including fruit juice.
negative.translationZh: 他发现，当食物（包括果汁）中的糖分提供过多热量时，会对血糖和胰岛素水平产生负面影响。

negative.sentenceEn: Advertising campaigns from the snack food companies, often featuring sports stars, send the message that we can neutralize any negative effects of consuming their products simply by getting more physical exercise.
negative.translationZh: 零食公司的广告活动通常由体育明星代言，传达出这样一种信息：只要增加体育锻炼，我们就能抵消食用其产品所带来的负面影响。
negative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

negative.sentenceEn: "For now, I think the negative reputation around games means that telling someone you're a determined gamer is more likely to harm your chances of getting a job. But if someone can explain how they've led a team in an online game, for example, they may be able to persuade an employer that this is useful," says Dr Barr.
negative.translationZh: 巴尔博士表示：“目前，我认为针对游戏的负面评价意味着，告诉别人你是一名资深玩家更有可能损害你的求职机会。但如果有人能够解释他们是如何在网络游戏中领导团队的，他们或许就能说服雇主，证明这项经历是有用的。”

negative.sentenceEn: Most of the coverage of the boom in wild camping has been negative .
negative.translationZh: 关于野外露营热潮的报道大多持负面态度。
negative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

negative.sentenceEn: A number of existing farming technologies could be used to reduce the negative effect of climate change on food production.
negative.translationZh: 多项现有农业技术可用于减轻气候变化对粮食生产的负面影响。

negative.sentenceEn: Both men and women were found to engage in negative behaviors.
negative.translationZh: 研究发现，男性和女性都会表现出这类消极行为。

nation.sentenceEn: W: You discuss three of those problems in the book, improving public education, reducing our nation 's healthcare burden, and increasing personal savings.
nation.translationZh: 女：您在书中讨论了其中三个问题：改善公共教育、减轻国家医疗负担，以及增加个人储蓄。
nation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

nation.sentenceEn: Environmental campaigners are struggling to understand why nations blessed with clean tap water grow only fonder of the bottle.
nation.translationZh: 环保活动人士难以理解，为何拥有清洁自来水的国家反而对瓶装水愈发青睐。

nation.sentenceEn: Now most people living in high-income nations are consuming enough protein.
nation.translationZh: 现在大多数生活在高收入国家的人都摄入了足够的蛋白质。
nation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

nation.sentenceEn: You can watch an online course about how to build a business or read an article about a terrible disaster in a developing nation , but that knowledge is unproductive unless you actually launch your business or donate to those in need.
nation.translationZh: 你可以观看如何创业的在线课程，或者阅读关于发展中国家重大灾难的文章，但除非你真正去创业或向需要帮助的人捐款，否则这些知识都是无用的。

nation.sentenceEn: Receiving education in a private university in the nation's capital may change the author's future life and that of her family's.
nation.translationZh: 在首都的一所私立大学接受教育可能会改变作者未来的生活及其家庭的未来。

nation.sentenceEn: Wealthy nations should solve their own food problems first.
nation.translationZh: 富裕国家应当首先解决自身的粮食问题。

network.sentenceEn: The human brain has the ability to constantly form new networks and connections between brain cells.
network.translationZh: 人脑具有不断形成脑细胞间新网络和连接的能力。
network.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

network.sentenceEn: In fact, researchers found that connections and thus communication—between parts of different brain networks are actually stronger in people who had hemispherectomies than in people with intact brains.
network.translationZh: 事实上，研究人员发现，在接受过半脑切除术的患者中，不同大脑网络各部分之间的连接——以及由此产生的交流——实际上比大脑完整的人更强。
network.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

network.sentenceEn: Today, the Earth Day Network , which rallies more than 20,000 partners and organizations in 190 countries, supports the Earth Day mission year-round.
network.translationZh: 如今，“地球日网络”在 190 个国家凝聚了超过 20,000 个合作伙伴及组织，全年致力于支持地球日的使命。
network.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

network.sentenceEn: The Earth Day Network pursues this mission through education, public policy, and activism campaigns.
network.translationZh: 地球日网络通过教育、公共政策以及行动主义运动来履行这一使命。
network.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

network.sentenceEn: Why did scientists choose to set up a 4G network in their mission?
network.translationZh: 为什么科学家们选择在他们的任务中建立4G网络？

network.sentenceEn: Set up a mobile phone network on the moon.
network.translationZh: 在月球上建立移动电话网络

necessarily.sentenceEn: Some folks are born with this take-in-the-world attitude, but those who aren't as genetically gifted aren't necessarily out of luck.
necessarily.translationZh: 有些人天生就有这种接纳世界的态度，但那些没有这种先天优势的人也未必运气不好。
necessarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

necessarily.sentenceEn: But that reduction doesn't necessarily make people think slower; as long as we are alive and functioning, we can alter our brains with new information and experiences.
necessarily.translationZh: 但这种衰退并不一定会让人思维变慢；只要我们活着且身体机能正常，我们就能通过新的信息和经历改变自己的大脑。
necessarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

necessarily.sentenceEn: They are doing work they care about and are interested in, and doing more of it is not necessarily a burden.
necessarily.translationZh: 他们正在做自己关心且感兴趣的工作，多做一些也未必是负担。

necessarily.sentenceEn: What I'm starting to realize, however, is that new knowledge does not necessarily drive new results.
necessarily.translationZh: 然而，我开始意识到，新知识并不一定能带来新成果。

necessarily.sentenceEn: Blue light isn't necessarily bad for us.
necessarily.translationZh: 蓝光对我们而言并非一定有害。
necessarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

necessarily.sentenceEn: Many scholars claim that spending time on electronic devices doesn't necessarily mean a decrease of time for other activities.
necessarily.translationZh: 许多学者声称，花时间使用电子设备并不一定意味着用于其他活动的时间会减少。

nursing.sentenceEn: "You know why most people in nursing homes use wheelchairs? Because the buildings are so big."
nursing.translationZh: 你知道为什么养老院里大多数人都坐轮椅吗？因为那些建筑实在太大了。
nursing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

nursing.sentenceEn: Even though animals in nursing homes were illegal at the time, Dr. Bill Thomas took a chance.
nursing.translationZh: 尽管当时养老院饲养动物属于违法行为，比尔·托马斯医生还是决定冒险一试。
nursing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

nursing.sentenceEn: Dr. Thomas's approach, named the Eden Alternative, has driven nursing homes to allow a more autonomous(自主的) and creative living space for their elderly.
nursing.translationZh: 托马斯医生将其方法命名为“伊甸园替代方案”，该方案促使养老院为老年人提供更加自主和富有创造性的生活空间。
nursing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

nursing.sentenceEn: It all started in 1991 when the Harvard-educated physician was transferred from working in a stressful emergency room to being the medical director of a nursing home in upstate New York.
nursing.translationZh: 这一切始于1991年，这位哈佛毕业的医生从压力重重的急诊室调任纽约州北部一家养老院的医疗主任。
nursing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

nursing.sentenceEn: Why did Bill Thomas try something different in the nursing home?
nursing.translationZh: 为什么比尔·托马斯要在疗养院尝试不同的做法？

nursing.sentenceEn: Nursing homes should be strictly limited in size.
nursing.translationZh: 养老院的规模应当受到严格限制。

native.sentenceEn: In Egypt, researchers have found buildings from around 3500 B.C., containing the remains of animals, including elephants, which were not native to Egypt.
native.translationZh: 在埃及，研究人员发现了约公元前3500年的建筑，其中包含动物遗骸，包括并非埃及本土物种的大象。
native.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

native.sentenceEn: They may carry viruses that are fatal to native snakes, which do not have resistance.
native.translationZh: 它们可能携带对本土蛇类致命的病毒，而本土蛇类对这些病毒没有抵抗力。
native.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

native.sentenceEn: The Fayetteville native believes driving a school bus allows her to give back to her community.
native.translationZh: 这位费耶特维尔本地人认为，驾驶校车让她能够回馈自己的社区。
native.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

native.sentenceEn: While lions are not native to China, some versions of the story include the villagers creating a monster of their own in the shape of a lion to fight off the beast.
native.translationZh: 虽然狮子并非中国本土动物，但在一些版本的故事中，村民们会制作出狮子形状的神兽来驱赶年兽。

native.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about the native foxes on the US island?
native.translationZh: 关于美国岛屿上的本土狐狸，这篇文章说了什么？

native.sentenceEn: Some natives were selling poor-quality food to tourists.
native.translationZh: 一些当地人向游客兜售劣质食品。

nutrition.sentenceEn: Similarly, nutrition research sponsored by the food industry is more likely to end up favoring the food under consideration than independently funded research.
nutrition.translationZh: 同样，由食品行业资助的营养研究比独立资助的研究更有可能得出有利于所研究食品的结论。
nutrition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

nutrition.sentenceEn: If you are a low-income student who will be attending school out-of-state, make sure you know if you can use your state benefits, such as the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, or SNAP.
nutrition.translationZh: 如果你是一名即将就读外州学校的低收入学生，一定要了解清楚是否可以使用本州福利，例如补充营养援助计划（SNAP）。

nutrition.sentenceEn: Public-health initiatives to promote healthy diets often focus on providing nutrition education and recipes(食谱).
nutrition.translationZh: 旨在促进健康饮食的公共卫生举措往往侧重于提供营养教育和食谱。
nutrition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

nutrition.sentenceEn: Nutrition scholar Marion Nestle of New York University spent a year informally tracking industry-funded studies on food.
nutrition.translationZh: 纽约大学的营养学学者马里昂·内斯特莱花了一年时间，非正式地追踪食品行业资助的相关研究。
nutrition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

nutrition.sentenceEn: What does Marion Nestle say about present-day nutrition studies?
nutrition.translationZh: 玛丽昂·内斯特尔对当今营养学研究有何看法？

nutrition.sentenceEn: It simply focuses on nutrition and health.
nutrition.translationZh: 它仅仅关注营养与健康。

narrow.sentenceEn: It could also help to enter these situations with clear guidelines and ideas of what you want from the range of options, which can narrow the possible choices, and also make you more confident about your ability to make the right decision.
narrow.translationZh: 此外，在面对这些情况时，如果能带着明确的准则，并对各种选项中你想要的结果心中有数，也会有所帮助。这不仅能缩小选择范围，还能让你更有信心做出正确的决定。
narrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

narrow.sentenceEn: People in France are keeping away from the narrow French stick loaf in favour of healthier, cheaper options, a millers' association has said.
narrow.translationZh: 一家磨坊主协会表示，法国人正逐渐不再购买细长的法式棍状面包，转而选择更健康、更便宜的替代品。
narrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

narrow.sentenceEn: Carey's ambitious plan is two-fold: first, change the business model of Formula One, which he said was a "one-man show" under Ecclestone that had a largely narrow vision when it came to negotiating partnership deals; and second, alter the way fans experience the sport, both in person and remotely, so that connections between the audience and people within the series are easier to make.
narrow.translationZh: 凯里的宏伟计划包含两个方面：首先，改变一级方程式的商业模式。他表示，在埃克莱斯顿领导下，这项运动基本上是一场"独角戏"，在洽谈合作协议时视野相当狭隘；其次，改变车迷体验这项运动的方式，无论是亲临现场还是远程观赛，都要让观众与赛事相关人员更容易建立联系。

narrow.sentenceEn: But among those who stayed on, the close losers performed even better than the narrow winners.
narrow.translationZh: 但在那些坚持下来的科学家中，惜败者的表现甚至比险胜者还要出色。

narrow.sentenceEn: According to one recent study, narrow winners of research grants had better chances to be promoted to professors.
narrow.translationZh: 根据最近的一项研究，勉强获得研究资助的科学家获得教授职位的几率更高。

narrow.sentenceEn: The gender gap tended to narrow to a significant degree.
narrow.translationZh: 这种性别差距往往会显著缩小

novel.sentenceEn: While genes can encourage an interest in doing new things, a 2012 study in the journal Psychology and Aging found completing reasoning tasks like puzzles and number games can enhance that desire for novel experiences, which can, in turn, refresh the brain.
novel.translationZh: 虽然基因可能会激发人们尝试新事物的兴趣，但2012年发表在《心理学与老龄化》期刊上的一项研究发现，完成拼图和数字游戏等推理任务可以增强这种对新奇体验的渴望，进而让大脑焕然一新。
novel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

novel.sentenceEn: In fact, scientists now suspect accumulating novel experiences, facts, and skills can keep people's minds more flexible.
novel.translationZh: 事实上，科学家们现在认为，不断积累新奇的体验、事实和技能可以让人的思维更加灵活。
novel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

novel.sentenceEn: Her first novel was not published until she was 39, and her last appeared when she was 84.
novel.translationZh: 她的第一部小说直到39岁才出版，而最后一部则在她84岁时问世。
novel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

novel.sentenceEn: Still, the idea that exercising for just 10 minutes a week may be enough to increase your lifespan is novel .
novel.translationZh: 尽管如此，每周仅锻炼10分钟就可能足以延长寿命的观点仍属新颖。
novel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

novel.sentenceEn: Using food as medicine is no novel idea, but the movement is making headway these days.
novel.translationZh: 将食物作为药物并非新颖理念，但这一运动如今正在取得进展。

novel.sentenceEn: They prefer to go after all that is novel .
novel.translationZh: 他们更喜欢追求一切新奇事物。

nap.sentenceEn: It claimed that it was important not to miss meals and that taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone.
nap.translationZh: 该说法称，不漏掉每一餐非常重要，且在飞机上睡个午觉是适应新时区的最佳方式。
nap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

nap.sentenceEn: The friends I have who still work in offices inform me their bosses insist that they take the second option, and that napping is associated with laziness.
nap.translationZh: 我那些仍在办公室工作的朋友们告诉我，他们的老板坚持让他们选择第二种方案，并且认为午睡与懒惰有关。
nap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句
文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

nap.translationZh: 这是一家专门提供小憩服务的场所。
nap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

nap.sentenceEn: At the Dreamery, a business in Manhattan, naps are for sale.
nap.translationZh: 在曼哈顿的“梦境空间”(Dreamery)，小睡也能明码标价。
nap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

nap.sentenceEn: Take a nap to adjust to a new time zone.
nap.translationZh: 通过午睡来适应新时区。

numerous.sentenceEn: Numerous studies have shown that drinking fruit juice doesn't make us consume any less of other foods throughout the day.
numerous.translationZh: 大量研究表明，饮用果汁并不会让我们在一天中减少其他食物的摄入量。

numerous.sentenceEn: Numerous writers produce masterpieces well into their 70s and beyond.
numerous.translationZh: 许多作家在70多岁甚至更年长时仍能创作出杰作。
numerous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

numerous.sentenceEn: Helping to look after a pet can facilitate numerous aspects of a child's emotional development.
numerous.translationZh: 帮助照顾宠物有助于促进孩子情感发展的多个方面。
numerous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

numerous.sentenceEn: What if fountains were more numerous , and tap water more clearly available in cafes, restaurants and elsewhere?
numerous.translationZh: 如果喷泉数量更多，咖啡馆、餐厅和其他地方能更方便地提供直饮水，那会怎么样呢？

numerous.sentenceEn: What do numerous studies show about infants?
numerous.translationZh: 大量研究表明婴儿有什么特点？

numerous.sentenceEn: It is competitive with its numerous tourist destinations.
numerous.translationZh: 法国凭借其众多的旅游景点具有很强的竞争力。

nowadays.sentenceEn: Nowadays , men eat an approximate average of 140 grams of bread daily, whereas women eat 80 to 90 grams.
nowadays.translationZh: 如今，男性平均每天食用约140克面包，而女性则食用80至90克。
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

nowadays.sentenceEn: Nowadays you can't buy anything without being asked to provide a rating of a company's performance on a five-star scale.
nowadays.translationZh: 如今，无论你买什么东西，都会被要求对公司表现进行五星评分。
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

nowadays.sentenceEn: Yet, there's no commercial farming of these birds nowadays .
nowadays.translationZh: 然而，如今已经没有这些鸟类的商业化养殖了。
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

nowadays.sentenceEn: Nowadays , American kids on average receive about $800 per year in allowance.
nowadays.translationZh: 如今，美国孩子平均每年能收到约800美元的零花钱。
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

nowadays.sentenceEn: Nowadays forests are increasingly welcome because they suck in carbon pollution from the air.
nowadays.translationZh: 如今，森林因其能吸收空气中的碳污染而愈发受到欢迎。
nowadays.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

nowadays.sentenceEn: What probably makes young women engineers more accepted nowadays ?
nowadays.translationZh: 如今年轻女性工程师更被接受的原因可能是什么？

nightmare.sentenceEn: "Parking here is already a nightmare ," one shouted at a protest rally.
nightmare.translationZh: “在这里停车简直就是场噩梦，”一个人在抗议集会上喊道。

nightmare.sentenceEn: Since your baby doesn't dream at this stage of brain development, it's safe to assume babies do not have nightmares , either.
nightmare.translationZh: 由于宝宝的大脑在这个发育阶段还不会做梦，因此可以肯定他们也不会做噩梦。
nightmare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

nightmare.sentenceEn: Nightmares stem from exposure to trauma(创伤), an overactive imagination, and the normal stresses of everyday life.
nightmare.translationZh: 噩梦源于经历创伤、想象力过于活跃以及日常生活的正常压力。
nightmare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

nightmare.sentenceEn: For a growing number of people, however, their yearly break is turning into a nightmare as they find that the property they have paid thousands for does not exist and the website through which they booked it has disappeared.
nightmare.translationZh: 然而，对于越来越多的人来说，他们一年一度的假期却变成了一场噩梦——他们发现自己花费数千英镑预订的房产根本不存在，而他们用来预订的网站也已消失得无影无踪。

nightmare.sentenceEn: What can we infer about nightmares from the passage?
nightmare.translationZh: 根据文章内容，关于噩梦我们可以推断出什么？

nightmare.sentenceEn: They have been disturbed by a nightmare .
nightmare.translationZh: 他们被一场噩梦所困扰。

nicotine.sentenceEn: People in both groups used nicotine (尼古丁) patches before they quit, in addition to a second form of nicotine replacement, like gum or spray.
nicotine.translationZh: 两组参与者在戒烟前均使用尼古丁贴片，此外还使用第二种尼古丁替代疗法，如口香糖或喷雾。
nicotine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

nicotine.sentenceEn: Ninety-two were found to have higher nicotine yields than they did six years previously.
nicotine.translationZh: 其中92个品牌的尼古丁含量较六年前有所上升。
nicotine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

nicotine.sentenceEn: However, none of them were prepared to comment on this study or discuss the detailed nicotine content of their products.
nicotine.translationZh: 然而，这些烟草公司无一准备对这项研究发表评论，也不愿讨论其产品尼古丁含量的详细数据。
nicotine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

nicotine.sentenceEn: Under the law in Massachusetts, tobacco companies have to measure the nicotine content of every type of cigarette and report the results.
nicotine.translationZh: 根据马萨诸塞州的法律，烟草公司必须测量每一种香烟的尼古丁含量并报告结果。
nicotine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

nicotine.sentenceEn: That worries the department because of the addictive nature of nicotine .

naturally.sentenceEn: Most foods containing fructose—a naturally occurring sugar found in all fruits and fruit juices—don't seem to have harmful effects as long as they're not contributing to excess daily calories.
naturally.translationZh: 大多数含有果糖（一种存在于所有水果和果汁中的天然糖分）的食物，只要不导致每日热量摄入过剩，似乎就不会产生有害影响。

naturally.sentenceEn: For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality and the power of influencing comes naturally .
naturally.translationZh: 对我们中的一些人来说，说服力是一种本能特质，影响他人的能力与生俱来。
naturally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

naturally.sentenceEn: Apparently, if you're more naturally driven to set goals, you are more likely to succeed.
naturally.translationZh: 显然，如果你天生更有设定目标的动力，你就更有可能成功。
naturally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

naturally.sentenceEn: Most of us might think that "natural flavors" are, well, naturally good for us.
naturally.translationZh: 我们大多数人可能会认为“天然香料”嘛，自然是对我们有益的。
naturally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

naturally.sentenceEn: Your child will naturally copy you, so it is important that you are seen reading and enjoying books, newspapers and magazines rather than just absorbed in screens.
naturally.translationZh: 孩子会很自然地模仿你，因此让他们看到你在阅读和享受书籍、报纸及杂志非常重要，而不只是沉迷于电子屏幕。
naturally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

naturally.sentenceEn: It has done better than naturally born dogs.
naturally.translationZh: 它比自然出生的狗表现更好。

neighborhood.sentenceEn: "They tend to be people with deep roots in the city, who have hung around since before the neighborhood became what it is today," he adds.
neighborhood.translationZh: “他们往往是在这座城市根基深厚的人，早在该街区变成现在这个样子之前，他们就已经在这里生活很久了，”他补充道。

neighborhood.sentenceEn: Arriving in their "Mystery Machine", the gang would have to find a monster who was terrorizing a neighborhood .
neighborhood.translationZh: 一行人乘坐他们的“神秘机器”抵达后，就必须找出那个正在恐吓社区的怪物。

neighborhood.sentenceEn: If that weren't already implied by the landscape—rolling green hills, palm trees, sun-kissed flowers—then it's evident in the many stories of people who grew up poor in these sleepy neighborhoods and rose to enormous success.
neighborhood.translationZh: 如果这一点尚未从当地的景致中流露出来——连绵起伏的青山、棕榈树、沐浴在阳光下的花朵——那么从许多人的故事中也能明显看出：他们在这些宁静的社区中出身贫寒，最终却取得了巨大的成功。

neighborhood.sentenceEn: The Chetty data shows that neighborhoods and places mattered for children born in the San Jose area of the 1980s.
neighborhood.translationZh: 切蒂的数据显示，对于20世纪80年代出生在圣何塞地区的儿童来说，社区和成长环境至关重要。

neighborhood.sentenceEn: People from poor neighborhoods tend to have the least interest in retraining.
neighborhood.translationZh: 贫困地区的居民往往对重新接受培训最不感兴趣。

neighborhood.sentenceEn: Find money to renovate the local neighborhood .
neighborhood.translationZh: 筹集资金翻新当地社区

newly.sentenceEn: The City of Fayetteville is making a special effort to recognize its bus drivers ahead of the newly proclaimed Transit Driver Appreciation Day happening Saturday.

newly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

newly.sentenceEn: This is according to the newly released study by Harvard Graduate School of Education professor Todd Smith.
newly.translationZh: 这是根据哈佛 Graduate School of Education 教授托德·史密斯最新发布的研究得出的结论。
newly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

newly.sentenceEn: W: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the newly scheduled gym classes.
newly.translationZh: 女：你好，我打电话来咨询一下新安排的健身课程。

newly.sentenceEn: What is the newly published study focused on?

norm.sentenceEn: In the coming era of budget cuts to education, distance learning could become the norm .
norm.translationZh: 在即将到来的教育预算削减时代，远程学习可能会成为常态。
norm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

norm.sentenceEn: Evil is typically referred to when there is deviance from social norms : formal deviance is the violation of laws, like theft, murder, and attacks, while informal deviance involves violations of social norms , like lying.
norm.translationZh: 当行为偏离社会规范时，我们通常会称之为邪恶：形式违规是指违反法律，如盗窃、谋杀和袭击；而非形式违规则涉及违反社会规范，如说谎。

norm.sentenceEn: However, deviance can also describe a behavior that simply differs from the norm .
norm.translationZh: 然而，偏差行为也可以指仅仅是与常规不同的行为。

norm.sentenceEn: Deviating from the norm can make us villains(恶棍), but it can also make us heroes.
norm.translationZh: 偏离常规可能使我们成为恶棍，但也能让我们成为英雄。

norm.sentenceEn: What mainly accounts for the possibility that distance learning could become the norm ?
norm.translationZh: 远程教育可能成为常态的主要原因是什么？

norm.sentenceEn: It will become the norm sooner or later.

nutrient.sentenceEn: Juices containing vegetables can provide more nutrients and less sugar than juices made up of just fruit—but they still lack valuable fibre.
nutrient.translationZh: 含蔬菜的果汁比纯水果制成的果汁能提供更多营养和更少糖分——但它们仍然缺乏宝贵的膳食纤维。

nutrient.sentenceEn: "There are a lot of nutrients contained in the parts of the fruits, such as in apple skins, that are excluded when you juice them," says Heather Ferris, a professor of medicine.
nutrient.translationZh: 医学教授希瑟·费里斯说：“水果的许多营养成分，比如苹果皮中的营养，在榨汁时都会被去除。”

nutrient.sentenceEn: Freshly juiced fruit has become a basic dietary item—especially for busy, health-conscious consumers who can save time on making (and perhaps even chewing) their food without missing out on nutrients .
nutrient.translationZh: 鲜榨果汁已成为基本饮食项目——尤其受到忙碌且注重健康的消费者青睐，他们可以节省制作（甚至咀嚼）食物的时间，同时又不会错过营养。

nutrient.sentenceEn: These include nutrient intake, sun exposure, climate, and disease exposure varying across the course of the year.
nutrient.translationZh: 这些因素包括全年变化的营养摄入、日照时间、气候条件和疾病接触情况。
nutrient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

nutrient.sentenceEn: One expert claims that juicing wastes a lot of nutrients contained in fruits.
nutrient.translationZh: 一位专家称，榨汁会浪费水果中含有的大量营养成分。

nutrient.sentenceEn: It provides all the nutrients for staying healthy.
nutrient.translationZh: 它提供保持健康所需的全部营养。

negatively.sentenceEn: But in the long term their performance is negatively affected.

negatively.sentenceEn: Although men's touching is more normal in these cultures, physical contact between persons of opposite sexes who are not family members is negatively perceived in Arabian countries.
negatively.translationZh: 尽管在这些文化中男性间的身体接触更为正常，但在阿拉伯国家，非家庭成员的异性之间的身体接触却会受到负面看待。
negatively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

negatively.sentenceEn: According to one survey, city design with bike lanes and pedestrian space did not negatively impact local businesses.
negatively.translationZh: 一项调查显示，包含自行车道和行人空间的城市设计并未对当地企业产生负面影响。

negatively.sentenceEn: Sleep may also be negatively affected by natural light.
negatively.translationZh: 自然光也可能对睡眠产生负面影响。

negotiate.sentenceEn: Carey's ambitious plan is two-fold: first, change the business model of Formula One, which he said was a "one-man show" under Ecclestone that had a largely narrow vision when it came to negotiating partnership deals; and second, alter the way fans experience the sport, both in person and remotely, so that connections between the audience and people within the series are easier to make.
negotiate.translationZh: 凯里的宏伟计划包含两个方面：首先，改变一级方程式的商业模式。他表示，在埃克莱斯顿领导下，这项运动基本上是一场"独角戏"，在洽谈合作协议时视野相当狭隘；其次，改变车迷体验这项运动的方式，无论是亲临现场还是远程观赛，都要让观众与赛事相关人员更容易建立联系。

negotiate.sentenceEn: In a new study, participants were told to imagine that they were negotiating for something important to them, like a house.
negotiate.translationZh: 在一项新研究中，参与者被要求想象自己正在为某件对他们很重要的东西进行谈判，比如一套房子。
negotiate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

negotiate.sentenceEn: Another role that they are expected to take over is negotiating on our behalf in commercial transactions or legal disputes.
negotiate.translationZh: 人们期望人工智能代理接管的另一项任务是代表我们进行商业交易或法律纠纷的谈判。
negotiate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

negotiate.sentenceEn: So, it's important to know whether using an artificial intelligence agent might affect how we negotiate .
negotiate.translationZh: 因此，了解使用人工智能代理是否会影响我们的谈判方式至关重要。
negotiate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

negotiate.sentenceEn: What did participants tend to do when assigned an AI agent to negotiate on their behalf?
negotiate.translationZh: 当被分配AI代理代表自己进行谈判时，参与者倾向于做什么？

negotiate.sentenceEn: They are better at negotiating an agreement.
negotiate.translationZh: 他们更擅长协商达成一致。

negotiation.sentenceEn: Participants then completed a survey indicating how tough, deceptive and pleasant or otherwise they wanted to be, or wanted their agent to be, in the negotiations .
negotiation.translationZh: 随后，参与者完成了一项调查，表明他们希望自己或希望其代理在谈判中表现得多么强硬、多么具有欺骗性、多么友善或采取其他何种态度。
negotiation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

negotiation.sentenceEn: "Collaboration, negotiation , decision-making, creativity, leadership, and increased physical activity are just some of the skills and benefits children gain through play," they wrote.
negotiation.translationZh: 他们写道：'合作能力、谈判能力、决策能力、创造力、领导力以及运动量的增加，这些仅仅是孩子们通过玩耍获得的部分技能和益处。'

negotiation.sentenceEn: She says the main reason the U.N. cultural organization didn't vote to declare Venice a World Heritage Site In Danger is because UNESCO has become "intensely politicized. There would have been some back-room negotiations ."
negotiation.translationZh: 她说，这个联合国文化组织没有投票宣布威尼斯为濒危世界遗产的主要原因是联合国教科文组织已变得“高度政治化。其中肯定有一些幕后谈判。”

negotiation.sentenceEn: And I knew it was a negotiation scheme, so I was able to say to myself, 'This is not real.'
negotiation.translationZh: 我知道这只是他们的谈判策略，所以我能告诉自己：'这不是真的。'

negotiation.sentenceEn: They are sensitive to the dynamics in the negotiation .
negotiation.translationZh: 他们对谈判中的动态变化很敏感。
negotiation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

necessity.sentenceEn: "For smart people, being wrong can feel like a personal attack, and being right, a necessity ."
necessity.translationZh: 对于聪明人而言，犯错会让他们感觉像是受到了人身攻击，而正确则成了一种必需品。
necessity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

necessity.sentenceEn: Big houses are advertised as a reward for hard work and diligence, turning housing from a basic necessity into a luxury.
necessity.translationZh: 大房子被宣传为辛勤工作的回报，这将住房从基本必需品转变为了奢侈品。
necessity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

necessity.sentenceEn: Buying a laptop proved a necessity and, thankfully, a relative bought me one as a gift.
necessity.translationZh: 购买笔记本电脑成了必需，好在有位亲戚送了我一台作为礼物。
它为她运送日常必需品。

negotiator.sentenceEn: This in turn helps us become better negotiators and abstract thinkers.
negotiator.translationZh: 这反过来帮助我们成为更出色的谈判者和抽象思考者。
negotiator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

negotiator.sentenceEn: But I think the really successful negotiator is probably born with the sixth sense that may respond properly to the situation at hand.
negotiator.translationZh: 但我认为真正成功的谈判者可能天生就具备一种第六感，能够对当前的情况做出恰当的反应。
negotiator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

negotiator.sentenceEn: W: And what about an unsuccessful negotiator ?
negotiator.translationZh: 女：那么，不称职的谈判者又是什么样的呢？

negotiator.sentenceEn: But I think successful negotiators have several things in common.
negotiator.translationZh: 但我认为成功的谈判者有几个共同之处。
negotiator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

negotiator.sentenceEn: Good negotiators learn fast, poor negotiators remain like that and go on losing negotiations.
negotiator.translationZh: 优秀的谈判者学习能力强，而不称职的谈判者则固守陋习，在谈判中一输再输。

negotiator.sentenceEn: What does the man say about good negotiators ?
negotiator.translationZh: 男士认为优秀的谈判者具备哪些特质？

normally.sentenceEn: They taught a series of dance moves to a group of patients with conditions like sleepwalking, in which the sleeper engages in the kind of physical movement that does not normally occur during sleep.
normally.translationZh: 他们向一组患有梦游等病症的患者教授了一系列舞蹈动作。这些患者在睡眠中会做出通常睡眠时不会发生的身体活动。
normally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

normally.sentenceEn: A question we often ask others and are also frequently asked by others is "What do you normally do after school or work?"
normally.translationZh: 我们经常问别人，也经常被别人问到的一个问题是：“放学后或下班后你通常做什么？”

normally.sentenceEn: Normally planes don't go to the polar post from February to October because of the dangers of flying in the pitch-dark and cold.
normally.translationZh: 通常情况下，由于在漆黑寒冷环境中飞行存在危险，每年2月至10月期间没有飞机前往这个南极科考站。

normally.sentenceEn: At other times the cow wandered around the 526-acre park and the artificial grass field normally used for human sporting events.
normally.translationZh: 其他时候，这头牛则在这座占地526英亩的公园里四处游荡，还跑到了通常供人们进行体育活动的人造草坪场上。

normally.sentenceEn: "I followed my route like I normally do," Smith told a reporter.
normally.translationZh: 史密斯在接受记者采访时表示：“我跟平时一样按路线投递。”

nutritional.sentenceEn: In an analysis of 155 studies, John Sievenpiper, associate professor at the University of Toronto's Department of Nutritional Sciences, set out to understand if the associations between sugary soft drinks and health—including risk of diabetes and heart disease—were applicable to the food and drink we generally consume as part of a healthy diet.
nutritional.translationZh: 多伦多大学营养科学系副教授约翰·西文派珀（John Sievenpiper）对155项研究进行了分析，旨在了解含糖软饮料与健康（包括糖尿病和心脏病风险）之间的关联是否适用于我们通常作为健康饮食一部分而消费的食品和饮料。

nutritional.sentenceEn: "Depending on a greater number of plant species creates a more vigorous and less risky food system—and one that provides a broader range of nutritional requirements."
nutritional.translationZh: 依赖更多种类的植物物种能够构建一个更具活力且风险更低的食物系统——同时也能提供更广泛的营养需求。

nutritional.sentenceEn: For example, a traditional Mediterranean diet includes fruits, vegetables, whole grains, nuts and olive oil as the main components of nutritional intake.
nutritional.translationZh: 例如，传统的地中海饮食以水果、蔬菜、全谷物、坚果和橄榄油作为营养摄入的主要成分。
nutritional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

nutritional.sentenceEn: The nutritional and health crises that followed the policy of structural adjustment, he says, led to many children and teenagers failing to reach their full potential in terms of height.
nutritional.translationZh: 他表示，结构调整政策引发的营养与健康危机，导致许多儿童和青少年无法充分发挥其身高潜力。
nutritional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

nutritional.sentenceEn: People who prioritise breakfasts tend to have lower calorie but higher nutritional intake.
nutritional.translationZh: 重视早餐的人往往摄入的热量较低，但营养摄入较高。

nutritional.sentenceEn: Vegetables differ in their nutritional value.
nutritional.translationZh: 不同蔬菜的营养价值各不相同。

narrative.sentenceEn: "Sports generally become popular in some way because they establish a narrative ," Bloom said.
narrative.translationZh: 布鲁姆说：“体育项目之所以能广受欢迎，通常是因为它们构建了一种叙事。”

narrative.sentenceEn: When I think of motorsports in the U.S., what we all think of is Nascar, and the narrative of Nascar is sort of rural, white, working-class Americans, mostly in the South, connecting with the atmosphere of those races.
narrative.translationZh: 当我想到美国的赛车运动时，我们首先想到的都是纳斯卡车赛。纳斯卡车赛的故事叙事，在某种程度上代表着美国南部乡村地区的白人工人阶级，他们与这些赛事的氛围紧密相连。

narrative.sentenceEn: When I think of the narrative of Formula One, it's a very different kind of audience.
narrative.translationZh: 而当我想到一级方程式赛车的叙事时，它面向的是一个截然不同的受众群体。

narrative.sentenceEn: They don't hear the narratives of how and why Southeast Asian refugees(难民) had to rebuild their lives here.
narrative.translationZh: 他们听不到东南亚难民是如何以及为何不得不在此重建生活的故事。

narrative.sentenceEn: The FrameWorks Institute, a research group that focuses on public framing of issues, has studied what sustains stereotypes and narratives of poverty in the United Kingdom.

narrative.sentenceEn: It is likely to change the narrative of one's life.
narrative.translationZh: 它可能会改变一个人的生命叙事。

nerd.sentenceEn: Wouldn't it work to have the government invest in the nerds ?

nerd.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

nerd.sentenceEn: You only need two kinds of people to create a technology hub(中心): rich people and nerds (痴迷科研的人).
nerd.translationZh: 创建科技中心只需两类人：富人和痴迷科研的人。
nerd.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

nerd.sentenceEn: It's not the kind of place nerds like.
nerd.translationZh: 迈阿密不是那种痴迷科研的人喜欢的地方。

nerd.sentenceEn: Few startups happen in Miami, for example, because although it's full of rich people, it has few nerds .
nerd.translationZh: 例如，迈阿密很少有初创企业，因为尽管那里富人云集，却鲜有痴迷科研的人。
nerd.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

nerd.sentenceEn: Within the US, towns have become startup hubs if and only if they have both rich people and nerds .
nerd.translationZh: 在美国，城镇要成为创业中心，当且仅当它们同时拥有富人和痴迷科研的人。

nerd.sentenceEn: It does not produce computer hackers and nerds .
nerd.translationZh: 它不会培养出电脑黑客和技术痴迷者。

net.sentenceEn: What's more, that section of road saw new businesses open, while Queens overall had a net loss.
net.translationZh: 更重要的是，那段路段有新商家开业，而皇后区整体却呈现净亏损。

net.sentenceEn: Using voice interaction feels far more intimate than surfing the net the old-fashioned way.
net.translationZh: 使用语音交互比传统的上网方式感觉要亲切得多。

net.sentenceEn: It is the safety net for those who fall off the edge of existence.
net.translationZh: 它是那些挣扎在生存边缘之人的安全网。
net.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

net.sentenceEn: And it's true: turning down opportunities is easier when you can fall back on the safety net provided by power, money, and authority.
net.translationZh: 这确实不假：当你拥有权力、金钱和权威作为安全保障时，拒绝机会会容易得多。

net.sentenceEn: Speaking ahead of the All Energy Conference being held in Glasgow, ScottishPower chief executive Keith Anderson said: "We have a large supply of renewable energy on our doorstep and one of the only two low emission zones in action across the UK. Now, we need to invest in the technologies and programmes that transform the rest of Glasgow's economy and make us net zero before anyone else."
net.translationZh: 在格拉斯哥举办的全能源会议前夕，苏格兰电力公司首席执行官基思·安德森表示：“我们家门口就有大量可再生能源供应，而且拥有全英国仅有的两个已投入运行的低排放区之一。现在，我们需要投资于能够改变格拉斯哥其他经济领域的技术和项目，让我们比其他任何城市都更早实现净零排放。”
net.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

net.sentenceEn: Some students waste much time surfing the net .
net.translationZh: 有些学生浪费很多时间上网。

neutral.sentenceEn: Since then, there have been a number of legal cases against companies involving paternity leave—including cases against JPMorgan Chase and Estee Lauder—which have helped put pressure on companies to make their parental leave policies gender neutral .
neutral.translationZh: 从那以后，出现了多起涉及陪产假的公司诉讼案件——包括针对摩根大通和雅诗兰黛的诉讼——这些案件促使企业面临压力，不得不将其育儿假政策调整为性别中立。

neutral.sentenceEn: Colour is now spreading through our homes, up staircases, across wood frames and ceilings, filling in neutral spaces.
neutral.translationZh: 如今，色彩正悄然融入我们的家居空间——沿着楼梯蜿蜒而上，点缀木质框架与天花板，为原本素净的空间增添活力。
neutral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

neutral.sentenceEn: If you are thinking to try colour on some of your neutral walls, the advice is refreshingly simple: Choose a colour you actually like.
neutral.translationZh: 如果你正考虑在某些中性色调的墙壁上尝试使用彩色，那么建议出奇地简单：选择一种你真正喜欢的颜色。
neutral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

neutral.sentenceEn: Glasgow has pledged to become the first carbon neutral city in the UK.
neutral.translationZh: 格拉斯哥已承诺成为英国首个碳中和城市。
neutral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

neutral.sentenceEn: The bored volunteers shocked themselves more and harder than the sad or neutral ones did.
neutral.translationZh: 感到无聊的志愿者比那些感到悲伤或情绪中性的志愿者更频繁、更强烈地电击自己。
neutral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

neutral.sentenceEn: A number of lawsuits have pressured companies to formulate gender neutral policies on parental leave.
neutral.translationZh: 多起诉讼已迫使企业制定性别中立的育儿假政策。

nutritious.sentenceEn: They're nutritious , inexpensive, and far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes on the market today.
nutritious.translationZh: 它们营养丰富、价格实惠，而且比当今市场上任何加工肉类替代品都要可持续得多。

nutritious.sentenceEn: We can easily think of a number of foods and recipes that are both inexpensive and nutritious .
nutritious.translationZh: 我们很容易想到许多既经济实惠又营养丰富的食物和食谱。
nutritious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

nutritious.sentenceEn: For example, low income is the strongest predictor of food insecurity in Canada, where one in eight households experiences insufficient access to nutritious foods.
nutritious.translationZh: 例如，在加拿大，低收入是粮食不安全的最强预测因素，该国八分之一的家庭无法充分获得营养食品。
nutritious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

nutritious.sentenceEn: But what was once advertised as nutritious is becoming unpopular.
nutritious.translationZh: 但曾经被宣传为营养丰富的牛奶正变得不受欢迎。
nutritious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

nutritious.translationZh: 它们被认为是最有营养的。
